# Wuxia UI Pack & Pixel Icon Notices

## 1. Kenney UI Pack / Pixel UI Pack Motifs (CC0 1.0 Universal)
* Creator: Kenney (https://kenney.nl / https://kenney-assets.itch.io/ui-pack)
* License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
* Usage: 9-slice corner plaque geometry, beveled button states, and RPG frame conventions adapted into CSS/SVG wuxia jade-tablet and bamboo-slip UI frames.

## 2. PixelArtIcons Grid Principles & Custom Wuxia SVG Icons (MIT License)
* Reference: PixelArtIcons by Halfmage (https://github.com/halfmage/pixelarticons)
* License: MIT License
* Usage: 24x24 pixel-grid icon construction combined with project-original wuxia martial arts, sect seal, and training icons in `dist/vendor/wuxia-ui-pack.js`.
